intro: This question helps us find the best place for you to begin.

widget.instructions: The Venn diagram places every element in its region. After you answer, it marks which of your elements belong.

stem: Write A − B in roster form.

hints.text: A − B keeps the elements of one set and removes the others. Which set do you start from?
Start with A. Remove every element that is also in B.

difference-order-reversed.text: That's B − A: elements of B that are not in A. A − B starts from A.

difference-vs-intersection.text: That's the overlap, A ∩ B. A − B is what's left of A after removing the overlap.

union-instead.text: That's A ∪ B, everything in either set. This question asks for something smaller.

difference-not-removed.text: That's all of A. Remove the elements that A shares with B.

difference-instead.text: That's A − B. The intersection is the overlap: elements in both sets.

generic.text: Place each element in the Venn diagram first, then read off the region you need.

workedSolution.text: Elements in both A and B: {{interStr}}.

difference-order-reversed.front: Is A − B the same as B − A?
difference-order-reversed.back: No. A − B: in A but not in B. B − A: in B but not in A.

difference-vs-intersection.back: A ∩ B is the overlap. A − B is the part of A outside the overlap.

union-instead.front: A ∪ B, A ∩ B, A − B: which is the largest?
union-instead.back: A ∪ B (everything in either set). A ∩ B and A − B are parts of it.

difference-not-removed.front: Forming A − B, what do you remove from A?
difference-not-removed.back: Every element that A shares with B.

difference-instead.back: Elements belonging to A and to B.

generic.front: How do you read a set operation off a Venn diagram?
generic.back: Place every element in its region, then shade the region the operation describes.

stem: Write A ∩ B in roster form.

hints.text: A ∩ B contains elements that satisfy a condition about both sets. Which condition?
Keep only the elements that appear in A and in B.
Look at the overlap of the two circles.

workedSolution.text: Go through A = {{Astr}} and keep each element that is also in B.
